findings.evidence: ComplexSpinDensity.lean:225-227 lists only `mat idxMM idxMM = mat idxPP idxPP`, `mat idxMP idxMP = mat idxPM idxPM`, `mat idxMM idxPP = mat idxPP idxMM`; the structure at ComplexSpinDensity.lean:86-91 has only `mat` and `posSemidef`, so entries such as `mat idxPP idxPM` are unconstrained. The docstring at ComplexSpinDensity.lean:216 asserts the full relation `A_{Λλ,Λ'λ'} = A_{-Λ-λ,-Λ'-λ'}`.
findings.fix: Define `IsParityInvariant ρ := ρ.mat.submatrix Fin.rev Fin.rev = ρ.mat` (`Fin.rev` is exactly the helicity flip idxPP↔idxMM, idxPM↔idxMP), keep the three current equations as derived lemmas, and restate `isParityInvariant_iff` as the surviving forward implication (plus a converse carrying the remaining imaginary-part equalities, or under `IsTimeReversalInvariant`). Strengthening `SpinDensity.IsParityInvariant` the same way keeps `isParityInvariant_toSpinDensityC_iff` true, since `ℝ → ℂ` is injective entrywise. Alternatively, add the forward selection rule (vanishing of the single-flip entries) as a hypothesis wherever parity is consumed, which makes the restricted relation equivalent to full parity.
findings.issue: `IsParityInvariant` is three equations among the entries that forward J_z conservation allows, but `SpinDensityC` never imposes that the other entries vanish. A matrix with a nonzero single-flip entry (e.g. `mat idxPP idxPM ≠ mat idxMM idxMP`) satisfies the predicate while violating the relation `A_{Λλ,Λ'λ'} = A_{-Λ-λ,-Λ'-λ'}` printed in its own docstring — and those are precisely the T-odd (Sivers/Boer-Mulders-type) entries the old Positivity.lean note gives as the reason for moving to ℂ. `isParityInvariant_iff` is likewise true only for the restricted predicate: with the full relation its right-to-left direction fails.

summary: The new PSD lemmas, the real/complex transfer, the Soffer bound and the saturating witness all check out mathematically and physically. One defect: SpinDensityC.IsParityInvariant states the parity relation only on the four collinear-allowed entries, so it does not express parity for exactly the matrices SpinDensityC exists to host.
